name: juniorgh
description: An offline-capable AI coding assistant powered by Github Copilot CLI, providing Copilot-like chat, code analysis, editing, and project scaffolding.

commands.title: JuniorGH: Open Chat in Editor Tab

enumDescriptions: Direct connection to an Azure OpenAI endpoint
Connection via an API Management proxy
Connection to the OpenAI API or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
juniorgh.api.provider.description: How to connect: 'azure' for a direct Azure OpenAI endpoint, 'apim' for an APIM proxy, 'openai' for the OpenAI API or compatible endpoints (GitHub Models, Ollama, etc.)

id.description: Model ID — Azure deployment ID or OpenAI model name (e.g. gpt-4o)

apiVersion.description: API version override — used for Azure OpenAI only (e.g., 2025-03-01-preview)

juniorgh.api.models.description: List of models available for selection. For Azure, use your deployment IDs. For OpenAI, use model names (e.g. gpt-4o, gpt-4.1). Works with all providers.

juniorgh.api.activeModel.description: Currently active model — Azure deployment ID or OpenAI model name, depending on provider.

juniorgh.api.apiKey.description: API key (fallback — prefer using 'JuniorGH: Set API Key' for secure storage). Sent as 'api-key' header for Azure, or 'Bearer' token for OpenAI.

juniorgh.azure.endpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint URL (e.g., https://your-resource.openai.azure.com). Used when provider is 'azure'.

juniorgh.azure.apiVersion.description: Azure OpenAI API version. Used when provider is 'azure' or 'apim'.

juniorgh.apim.baseUrl.description: APIM gateway base URL including path prefix (e.g., https://my-apim.azure-api.net/foundryapi). Used when provider is 'apim'.

juniorgh.openai.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API. Include /v1 for OpenAI proper. Examples: 'https://api.openai.com/v1' (OpenAI), 'https://models.inference.ai.azure.com' (GitHub Models), 'http://localhost:11434/v1' (Ollama). Used when provider is 'openai'.

juniorgh.maxTokens.description: Maximum completion tokens in AI response (output limit, not context window).

juniorgh.workspace.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes to index

juniorgh.workspace.excludePatterns.description: Glob patterns to exclude from workspace indexing

juniorgh.agent.provider.description: Agent backend to use for chat turns. 'native' uses Junior's built-in Azure/OpenAI loop. 'copilot-cli' delegates the agent runtime to a local GitHub Copilot CLI ACP server.

juniorgh.agent.maxIterations.description: Maximum number of tool-call iterations per agent turn

juniorgh.agent.contextWindow.description: Model context window size in tokens. Older messages are summarized when approaching this limit. Common values: 128000 (GPT-4o/4.1), 200000 (Claude).

juniorgh.agent.contextThreshold.description: Fraction of the context window (0.3–0.95) at which older messages are summarized. Lower values trim more aggressively.

juniorgh.agent.confirmWrites.description: Ask for user confirmation before writing/deleting files

juniorgh.agent.confirmTerminal.description: Ask for user confirmation before running terminal commands

juniorgh.agent.autoInvestigate.description: Before the first model call, automatically gather likely issue context from diagnostics, active files, and semantic retrieval.

juniorgh.agent.autoInvestigateMaxFiles.description: Maximum number of likely files to pull into the agent's preflight investigation summary.

juniorgh.copilotCli.path.description: Executable path for GitHub Copilot CLI when agent.provider is set to 'copilot-cli'.

juniorgh.copilotCli.home.description: Optional COPILOT_HOME override used when launching the Copilot CLI runtime.

juniorgh.copilotCli.model.description: Active model for the Copilot CLI runtime. Select from the models listed in juniorgh.copilotCli.models or enter any model name supported by the CLI.

id.description: Model ID passed to the Copilot CLI (COPILOT_MODEL)

juniorgh.copilotCli.models.description: List of models available for selection in the model picker. Each entry has a display name and an id passed to the Copilot CLI. An entry with an empty id means 'use the Copilot CLI default model'. Use settings.default.json with deploy.ps1 to bake in a customer-specific list.

juniorgh.copilotCli.additionalArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to Copilot CLI when running as an ACP server.

juniorgh.copilotCli.autoApproveWrites.description: Automatically approve file-write permission requests from the Copilot CLI agent without prompting. Reduces latency but gives the agent unrestricted edit access.

juniorgh.copilotCli.autoApproveTerminal.description: Automatically approve terminal/execute permission requests from the Copilot CLI agent without prompting.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerBaseUrl.description: BYOK: API endpoint URL (COPILOT_PROVIDER_BASE_URL). Setting this activates Bring-Your-Own-Key mode, bypassing GitHub Copilot authentication.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerType.description: BYOK: Provider type (COPILOT_PROVIDER_TYPE). Use 'azure' for Azure OpenAI, 'anthropic' for Claude, or leave empty for openai-compatible.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerApiKey.description: BYOK: API key for the provider (COPILOT_PROVIDER_API_KEY). Optional for local providers like Ollama.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerAzureApiVers.description: BYOK: Azure-specific API version (COPILOT_PROVIDER_AZURE_API_VERSION). Required when providerType is 'azure'.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerBearerToken.description: BYOK: Bearer token authentication (COPILOT_PROVIDER_BEARER_TOKEN). Takes precedence over API key if both are set.

juniorgh.copilotCli.providerWireApi.description: BYOK: Wire protocol (COPILOT_PROVIDER_WIRE_API). Defaults to 'completions' if unset.

juniorgh.mcp.servers.description: MCP server configurations. Each key is a server name. Use { command, args?, env?, cwd? } for stdio or { url, headers? } for HTTP transport. Entries here override duplicate names loaded from external settings.

command.description: Command to launch the MCP server (stdio transport)

args.description: Arguments for the MCP server command

env.description: Environment variables for the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server

url.description: HTTP endpoint URL for the MCP server (HTTP transport)

headers.description: Extra HTTP headers (e.g. Authorization) for the MCP server

authSession.description: Populate auth headers for an HTTP MCP server from a VS Code authentication provider session.

providerId.description: VS Code authentication provider ID, for example github

scopes.description: Optional scopes to request from the auth provider

tokenHeader.description: Header name that should receive the access token

tokenScheme.description: Prefix to prepend before the access token, for example Bearer

createIfNone.description: Prompt the user to sign in if no matching session is already available

juniorgh.mcp.includeExternalServers.description: Also load MCP servers from other VS Code settings keys (for example, mcp.servers from the official MCP extension).

juniorgh.mcp.externalServerSettings.description: List of settings paths to read additional MCP server definitions from. Format: "section.key".

juniorgh.inlineCompletions.model.description: Model for inline completions: Azure deployment ID (provider 'azure'/'apim') or OpenAI model name (provider 'openai'). Leave empty to use the active chat model. A fast model (e.g. gpt-4o-mini) is recommended.

juniorgh.inlineCompletions.timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an inline completion response before aborting. Lower values feel snappier but may discard slower responses.

juniorgh.inlineCompletions.candidates.description: Number of alternative completions to fetch (1–3). Use Alt+] / Alt+[ to cycle between candidates. Higher values use more API calls per suggestion.

juniorgh.slashCommands.directories.description: Additional directories to scan for slash command .md files. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace root. Built-in directories (.juniorgh/commands, .github/copilot/commands, .github/commands) are always scanned.
